text_block_list.text:
I came to a shrine today to pray for 
Mejiro Bright's slump to clear up, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I look forward to working with you 
today.
choice_data_list:
Shall we purify our hands at the water 
basin first, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hold on~. Let's calm down first before 
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're communing with the gods, we 
must purify our hearts as well~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, take the ladle in your right hand 
and purify your left hand~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Next, using the cleansed left hand, switch 
the ladle over and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Our bodies and minds are thoroughly 
purified now~ Next, let's head over to the 
torii gate—

Following the proper shrine etiquette with 
utmost care like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes our shrine visit. Thank 
you for accompanying me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I truly want you to cure this slump 
no matter what, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I shall reach the heights eventually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And not merely reaching that point, 
either. It must be done with grace, 
brilliance, and dignity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Because that is the kind of Mejiro 
Umamusume I strive to be."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is only a minor slump, I cannot 
allow myself to show such an unsightly 
state.

I see. That's a very Mejiro Bright reason. 
If so, I'd really love for her wish to be 
granted, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hop, hop, hop♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Look at this~♪ That heavy, gloomy feeling 
has completely vanished.
choice_data_list: Must be thanks to your prayer!
It's all thanks to the prayer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We simply must go convey our thanks, 
mustn't we? Please come along with me, 
Trainer~.

This is to celebrate her recovery. I have 
to properly express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wawa――

Suddenly, Mejiro Bright stumbled and 
nearly fell over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry~ I felt a slight dizzy 
spell...

It seems she lost her balance from 
standing for such a long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It certainly does not happen 
overnight, does it?
